freeze_method: Flat SHA256/size references resolved recursively from administrative JSON paths. Bytes hashed, not copied; path-like unresolved strings are not completeness or validity claims. Frozen refs are deliberately broader than actually used evidence. No history/corpus tree copied.
root_manifest_verification: all listed file bytes checked read-only; upstream verifier not run
corpus_verification: all twenty original chunks checked against original r301 manifest before selected-record parsing
corpus_origin: dated third-party probxiv mirror per r301; not current MathDB validation
r363_rule: No credit for a new smaller witness to a source-already-refuted assertion
evidence_limits: Literal review of fifty; related primary bodies for nine records; no original workshop bodies; no full successor-resolution/dependency audit; no exhaustive corpus or literature coverage claim.
